definition.simple: The amount of force pushing on a specific area. Imagine stepping on a balloon with a flat shoe versus a high heel!
definition.academic: Pressure is defined as the physical force exerted on an object. The force applied is perpendicular to the surface of objects per unit area.

examples: Pumping air into a bicycle tyre
A sharp knife cutting vegetables easily compared to a blunt knife

common_misconceptions: Students often confuse pressure with force. They are related but pressure is force per unit area.
ai_context.tutor_hint: Ask the student: Why does a camel walk easily on sand but we sink?
